name: Feature or research proposal
about: Suggest a scoped architecture/compiler improvement or falsifiable experiment
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

### Research or engineering goal
State the missing feature or exact research question.

### Proposed interface and boundaries
Identify expected source folder, inputs/outputs, supported models/devices and whether this is product code, a source-only experiment or a native experiment.

### Acceptance criteria
Specify observable tests, independent checks, matched baselines, negative controls and metrics including latency (not cycles alone) where relevant.

### Evidence and permissions
Reference exact source revisions; never assume access to institutional/proprietary IP or private model weights. Native FPGA tools require a separately approved protocol; do not request GitHub Actions.
